about: The page list scripts/snapshot-real-pages.mjs reads for corpus/heldout. Every entry names the licence that permits vendoring a modified copy (inlining CSS is a modification) and the URL of the licence page that was read when the page was chosen. Ids are category and a counter rather than a name, because published tables identify a page by category and digest; see NOTICE.md.
